question: The horizontal rows in the modern periodic table are called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**periods**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **​The horizontal rows of the periodic table are called periods**__.

 __
 
• The elements in the periodic table are arranged in rows.
 
• Elements of the** same period have the same number of electron orbitals**.
 
 
 
• **Group -**
 
 
• There are** 18 vertical columns **in the periodic table.
 
• All elements in a group have similar chemical and physical properties.
 
• Because they have the same number of outer electrons.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The current periodic table** includes **118 known elements.**

 
 
• **Atomic mass -**

 
 
• It is the mass of the subatomic particle or nucleus.
 
 
 
• **Mass number -**
 
 
• It is the sum of the number of neutrons and the number of protons present in the nucleus of an atom of an element.
 
 
 
• **Atomic number -**
 
 
• It is the number of protons present in the nucleus of an atom of an element.
